recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit this CodeSystem section only through a separate reconciliation if FHIR-54129 or another later technical correction reaches an Applied/Published state.
issue_request: FHIR-14701 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocab clarification asking what the existing statement that there should only be one CodeSystem resource meant, specifically whether it meant one globally or one on each server. The accepted resolution clarified that the intended singleton is the authoritative CodeSystem from the code system publisher, identified by canonical URI, with multiple copies distributed and used where needed.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was pre-applied in SVN r13341. Git-svn commit 080e47c1a06da8867d5f876ed2bb2d528dc64632 changed source/codesystem/codesystem-introduction.xml from the ambiguous sentence to the authoritative-publisher wording. Commit 12be056c1dbf0232cdeeb63938d950eea232307a immediately fixed the duplicated 'be' and improved the distribution wording, and 6f7c3716ef8e176e5ea811ceb12844b81a3904ec later changed canonical URI language to canonical URL without changing the FHIR-14701 meaning.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, and the latest combined branch contains the clarified wording at source/codesystem/codesystem-introduction.xml:87-88. FHIR-20478 later revisited NamingSystem/CodeSystem boundary text and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-54129 proposes R6 technical corrections to the same section, but it is not Applied/Published and its comments record unresolved editor concerns, so it was treated only as later context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current build-scope CodeSystem introduction already answers the seed question and no final later decision requires a different current wording.
